PDF text extraction; layout and embedded images are not reproduced.

[Source page 1]

DE ULISTEDE PARTIERS VALGNAT

      ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

      -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

   The Synthetic Party invites to a completely alternative election night for all the parties,

   that did not get on the ballot this year. We hope you have/I have the desire to participate!

  Come and experience the WORLD'S BIGGEST PARTY LEADERS' ROUND, and talk with MEDIA.


  Show up Tuesday 1 November from 19-00 at Erik Husfeldtsvej 7, 2630,

   Høje Taastrup! Registration only requires that this email is answered with how many

   of you will come (first come first served, max. 193). Food/drinks are purchased on site.


    We are writing here to you from The Synthetic Party, which is driven by an "artificial

    intelligence." We are currently only missing 20.170 voter declarations to run for

    parliamentary election. But the window closes already here on 17/10. So what do we do now?


   YES, WE CAN acknowledge ALL PARTIES' contributions to the democratic system.

   And from our side, we actually could not exist as a party without you. Because since

    spring we have collected texts from all microparties' programs, while we

   have programmed our own artificial intelligence - Leder Lars. Our party

    is thus an algorithmic mishmash of these very unique political visions.


  With The Synthetic Party we offer special exposure to your platforms,

    since our technological background means we are subject to global attention,

  which we want to share with you. If we can't scoop up more votes, let's

    get our voices out!

    * Most heartfelt greetings, from your comrades in The Synthetic Party
